one_line: OpenAI and Anthropic disproved the Exponential Time Hypothesis, while election results, export controls, and security vulnerabilities dominated industry news.

themes.title: AI models disprove Exponential Time Hypothesis
themes.text: OpenAI and Anthropic stated that their AI models disproved the 27-year-old Exponential Time Hypothesis, publishing their proofs on GitHub in natural language and Lean format.

stories.headline: OpenAI and Anthropic AI models disprove Exponential Time Hypothesis

themes.title: U.S. examines Nvidia chips and espionage risks
themes.text: A U.S. intelligence memo claimed a Megaspeed executive was recruited to spy on Nvidia's CEO, while the Commerce Department approved Chinese firms with empty offices to handle Nvidia chips.

stories.headline: US approved Chinese firms with empty offices to handle Nvidia chips

themes.title: Super PACs and data centers face midterm shifts
themes.text: The Anthropic-backed Public First PAC spent over $63 million in the midterms, while pro-AI network Leading the Future fell short and Democrats won victories leading to voter rejection of data centers.

themes.text: Researchers found that Claude Code approval files exposed database passwords on public GitHub repositories, and a Wyoming woman joined a lawsuit against xAI over Grok child deepfakes.
